## Deviation notes (design decisions recorded up front)

1. **`outline-from-research` is NOT in the upstream pin.** The vendored pin at
   `5fef4165042b080c1d4c6becc281dc5ce8860cb3` carries only `bootstrap-persona`,
   `draft-from-outline`, `editorial-review`, `respond-to-review` — the ticket's "port … at the
   upstream pin" instruction cannot apply verbatim. Following the P1.11 precedent for skills the
   spec schedules but upstream lacks (`research-burst`, `chat-turn`), `outline-from-research` is
   authored Rhema-owned and declared in `upstream-port.manifest.mjs`'s `rhemaOwned` list with a
   dated note. `check-upstream-diff.mjs` stays green; the REQ-SPEC-22 contract test still covers it.
2. **`projects.status` is computed, not stored** — there is no `status` column (project state is
   derived in `@rhema/orchestrator`'s `projectState` from `outlinePresent` = a `kind:'outline'`
   artifact row, the same seam P1.04's outline upload feeds). The ticket's
   `projects.status='outlined'` lands as: approval writes the `outline` artifact → the computed
   state reads `outlined` and suggests `draft_v1`. Verified via `projectState`, no column added.
3. **Seat = `assistant`** (already frozen in `SEAT_BY_WORKFLOW`, §7.1's workflow column). The
   Assistant↔Drafter wall is preserved structurally: the assistant seat mounts `agents/author/**`
   read-only **only** under `agents/author/outline/**` (the new conduit mount), and the run's
   declared `agents/author/outline/<slug>.{md,json}` outputs gain readwrite through the existing
   `declaredWritableArtifacts` grant — the outline artifact IS the sanctioned conduit
   (REQ-SPEC-15). `ASSISTANT_AGENT_TYPE.denies` gains the matching `!agents/author/outline/**`
   exception so the deny glob cannot swallow the grant.
4. **Last-phase gate resume.** `gateAfter` on the run's last phase opens the gate correctly, but
   resolution previously resumed the pod into "no uncommitted phases remain". `resolveGate` /
   `autoResolveGate` now detect an all-phases-committed gate and transition
   `waiting_gate → finalizing` + enqueue `run.finalize` (new worker job) instead of `run.resume`.
   This is where approval consequences live: `finalizeRun` gains an `outline` branch
   (`outline-delivery.ts`) that seals the outline head immutable, copies the thread's source notes
   to `agents/author/research/` (copy — assistant notes intact), writes the author research index,
   and emits `outline.approved` with the next-step fact (Draft v1, or `/draft @section` when a
   draft exists).
5. **Outline twin convention.** The gate/editor sidecar rides the existing `<md>.json` twin
   convention (`agents/author/outline/<slug>.json`, declared as a second phase artifact — the
   writable grant covers both) while the completion oracle validates
   `agents/assistant/.rhema/outline.json` (same schema). `serializeGateOverlay` gains
   `outline → outline.json` via a new `serializeOutline` (sidecar rows → `.md` + `.json`).
6. **`<slug>` placeholder.** Declared artifact paths gain a third placeholder (`<slug>`, one path
   segment) alongside `vN`/`v(N+1)`/`<run>` — expanded at hydration from the frozen
   `inputs.outlineSlug`, matched at harvest by the existing template machinery.

## Plan

1. Contracts: `outline.json` sidecar schema (+ registry + contract hint), gate-edit claim/section
   extensions, `approve_outline` defaults already wait — assert; seat mount + denies exception.
2. Protocols: `skills/outline-from-research/` (Rhema-owned, six-input + phase-result shape),
   `manifests/outline.ts` (harvest package → classify judge → spine generate → gaps judge +
   `approve_outline` gate + spine 5–12 bound), `ESTIMATORS.outline`
   (`20 + 0.004·thread_tokens + 6·urls_refetched`), `outline.json` serializer + md-twin,
   `WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS`/`WORKFLOW_LABELS` registration, `<slug>` expansion.
3. Orchestrator: `<slug>` expansion in `expandDeclaredPath`/`versionTemplateRegex`/runspec
   `phase_output`; last-phase-gate `finalizing` + `run.finalize` job; `finalizeRun` outline branch
   (`outline-delivery.ts`).
4. Worker: `run.finalize` handler.
5. API: promotion endpoints (`POST …/threads/:tid/outline`, turn-scoped variant, `/outline`
   command + plan-decision action), run-sheet builder with thesis/venue/target length/protocol/
   voice + estimate pre-pass; outline routes (GET/PATCH autosave+versioning/DELETE-cited-409/
   gap Answer → `user_typed` claim); gate DTO `approve_outline` structured body + draft estimate
   fact; registry/label plumbing.
6. UI: shared spine-and-sections component (extracted from the Approve-plan card's fields, used
   unlocked by the outline editor); `approve_outline` gate card (gaps + unverified count + Draft
   estimate; Approve / Edit in outline editor / Back to chat); web outline editor page
   (autosave, live `ESTIMATORS.draft` line, phone read-only).
7. Gates: build/lint/typecheck, `pnpm test`, upstream-diff, protocol-markers, build-memory.

## What landed (Stage A)

- **Contracts** — `outline.json` sidecar (thesis/levers/provenance header/`spine` claim-id
  order/`sections[]` rows with `ref·title·targetWords·function·entry·exit·claims[]`/
  `alternativesConsidered`/`gaps[]`; claim `provenance{kind,turnId,url,notePath}` +
  `unverified` as DATA), registry + contract hint + the-politics-of-visibility fixture;
  `outline.approved` run event (validated payload: slug/artifactId/versionId/copiedNotes);
  `ASSISTANT_AGENT_TYPE.denies` gains the `!agents/author/outline/**` exception.
- **Protocols** — `skills/outline-from-research/SKILL.md` (Rhema-owned; declared in
  `upstream-port.manifest.mjs`'s `rhemaOwned`; the re-fetch contract is load-bearing —
  failed fetch ⇒ `[unverified]` claim, never a drop/substitution); `manifests/outline.ts`
  (harvest package → classify judge → spine generate → gaps judge + `approve_outline` WAIT
  gate bound to `<slug>.md`, `outline_spine_bound` 5–12); `ESTIMATORS.outline`
  (`20 + 0.004·thread_tokens + 6·urls_refetched` + fixed per-phase overhead); `parseOutline`
  + `serializeOutline` + `renderOutlineMd`/`parseOutlineMd` (`<!-- rhema:outline v1 -->`);
  `WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS`/`WORKFLOW_LABELS` registration; `<slug>` declared-path placeholder.
- **Orchestrator** — `<slug>` expansion (hydration/runspec `phase_output`); last-phase-gate
  resolution → `finalizing` + new `run.finalize` job (was pod-resume into no-op);
  `outline-delivery.ts` — seal the outline head, copy thread source notes to
  `agents/author/research/` (content-addressed, dedupe on identical bytes, index merge),
  emit `outline.approved`; gate overlays serialize outline `.md` + `.json` twins.
- **Worker** — `run.finalize` handler.
- **API** — `outline-routes.ts` (634 lines): promotion facts + run create (the sheet's click
  is the consent), editor GET DTO, PATCH (full doc or `ed.*` delta → one version pair;
  server re-stamps provenance/`unverified`), DELETE 409 while cited (`outline_cited`),
  gap Answer → `user_typed` claim; gate DTO `approve_outline` structured body
  (`outlineViewFromSidecar`) + `outlineSlug` fact; draft create accepts `outlineArtifactId`.
- **Web/UI** — `OutlineSections` shared spine-and-sections editor (approve_outline card +
  `/p/:slug/outline`, `ed.*` grammar, provenance/`[unverified]` badges never editable,
  phone read-only); promotion sheet (scope/sources/urls/estimate+cap — the consent);
  `/outline` chat verb interception; `outline.js` autosave island (~2 KB, progressive
  enhancement — no-JS Save posts the same form); `outline.approved` feed template.

## Sizing notes

Ticket sized 1 in the manifest; landed 51 files / +3,441 (code commit) + 3 targeted test
files (+~0.9 K) + build memory — the largest single
seat-adjacent workflow so far, but each layer is thin (one manifest, one sidecar, one shared
component, one routes file). The 4-phase manifest + reuse of P1.09 gate machinery and P1.11's
research namespace kept it inside the size-1 envelope.
